name: Sage Estimating
summary: Commercial estimating software with RSMeans cost-database integration and takeoff links, from Sage.
differentiator: Worth it mainly for contractors already on Sage 100 Contractor or Sage 300, because budgets, purchase orders and subcontracts export without rekeying. It is still a server-based product with cloud-adjacent features, and reported costs run from $4,000 to $8,000 per seat per year before the separate RSMeans database subscription.
pricing: Not published. Third-party sources report $4,000 to $8,000 per seat per year for Standard, $10,000 to $20,000+ per year for Advanced, RSMeans data at $1,500 to $3,000 per user, and 15 to 20 percent annual maintenance.
whoPays: Subscriber pays per seat; maintenance fees extra
entryPrice: Quote; reported $4,000 to $8,000 per seat per year
bestFor: Commercial GCs and subs on the Sage accounting stack.
skipIf: You are a small contractor who wants cloud software and a transparent price.
